B=http://localhost:8080/api/tasks; J='Content-Type: application/json'; W='\n== %{http_code}\n'
echo "## R3 backend-dev phase-03 (US1) $(date -Is) today=2026-09-26" >> curl.log
curl -sS --create-dirs -o api/r3-c1.json -D api/r3-c1.head -w 'C1 %{http_code}\n' -X POST -H "$J" -d '{"title":"C1 Buy milk R","description":"2 litres","priority":"HIGH","dueDate":"2026-10-01"}' $B; grep -i content-type api/r3-c1.head; jq -c . api/r3-c1.json
ID=$(jq .id api/r3-c1.json); curl -sS -o api/r3-c1get.json -w 'C1-get %{http_code}\n' $B/$ID; jq -S . api/r3-c1.json > api/a.json; jq -S . api/r3-c1get.json > api/b.json; cmp api/a.json api/b.json && echo C1-get-same
curl -sS -w "$W" -X POST -H "$J" -d '{"title":"C1 defaults"}' $B; echo
echo "--- C2"; for b in '{"title":""}' '{"title":"   "}' '{"description":"x"}' "$(jq -nc '{title:("t"*201)}')"; do curl -sS -D api/h -o api/r.json -w '%{http_code} ' -X POST -H "$J" -d "$b" $B; grep -io 'problem+json' api/h | tr '\n' ' '; jq -c '[.errors[]|{field,message}]' api/r.json; done
curl -sS -o api/r.json -w '200-char %{http_code} ' -X POST -H "$J" -d "$(jq -nc '{title:("t"*200)}')" $B; jq '.title|length' api/r.json
curl -sS -D api/h -o api/r.json -w 'PUT empty %{http_code} ' -X PUT -H "$J" -d '{"title":"","status":"TODO","priority":"HIGH"}' $B/$ID; grep -io 'problem+json' api/h|tr '\n' ' '; jq -c '[.errors[]|.field]' api/r.json
curl -sS -D api/h -o api/r.json -w 'PUT 201 %{http_code} ' -X PUT -H "$J" -d "$(jq -nc '{title:("t"*201),status:"TODO",priority:"HIGH"}')" $B/$ID; grep -io 'problem+json' api/h|tr '\n' ' '; jq -c '[.errors[]|.field]' api/r.json
echo "--- C3"; curl -sS -D api/h -o api/r.json -w 'POST 2001 %{http_code} ' -X POST -H "$J" -d "$(jq -nc '{title:"C3 long",description:("d"*2001)}')" $B; grep -io 'problem+json' api/h|tr '\n' ' '; jq -c '[.errors[]|.field]' api/r.json
curl -sS -o api/r.json -w 'POST 2000 %{http_code} ' -X POST -H "$J" -d "$(jq -nc '{title:"C3 2000",description:("d"*2000)}')" $B; jq '.description|length' api/r.json
curl -sS -D api/h -o api/r.json -w 'PUT 2001 %{http_code} ' -X PUT -H "$J" -d "$(jq -nc '{title:"C1 x",description:("d"*2001),status:"TODO",priority:"HIGH"}')" $B/$ID; grep -io 'problem+json' api/h|tr '\n' ' '; jq -c '[.errors[]|.field]' api/r.json
echo "--- C4"; for m in 'POST|{"title":"C4","status":"FOO"}' 'POST|{"title":"C4","priority":"FOO"}' 'PUT|{"title":"C4 changed","status":"FOO","priority":"LOW"}' 'PUT|{"title":"C4 changed","status":"DONE","priority":"URGENT"}' 'PUT|{"title":"C4 changed","status":null,"priority":"LOW"}'; do u=$B; [ "${m%%|*}" = PUT ] && u=$B/$ID; curl -sS -D api/h -o api/r.json -w "${m%%|*} %{http_code} " -X "${m%%|*}" -H "$J" -d "${m#*|}" $u; grep -io 'problem+json' api/h|tr '\n' ' '; jq -c '[.errors[]?|.field]' api/r.json; done
curl -sS -w "$W" $B/$ID | jq -c '{title,status,priority}' 2>/dev/null || curl -sS $B/$ID
